scores.tell: Whole card is pale and low-contrast. The hazy pastel city and the grey-blue binoculars sit in the same mid-light values, so the hero separates from the background only weakly. Real cards have a clear value step between hero and background.

The bright sky and sea read as one light group. The dark posts sit against it and the pier is mid-value, which is fairly close to real cards. The sea is busy with local contrast and the corners are not darkened.
none. The saturated orange planet and yellow ring stand out strongly against the mid-value purple stripes. Local contrast inside the hero is gentle, as on real cards.
The black pentagons are the darkest accents and cover a large area. The grass is busy and the dark blades along the bottom are heavy. The shadows are murkier than on real cards.
none. The dark navy body against the yellow background separates by both value and hue. The key tones are tidy and the local contrast is gentle.
The pale lilac background and the white and blue helmet sit in a narrow value range. The glossy yellow visor is the only strong accent, and the base is low in contrast against the background.

The mid-value golden rope separates from the purple background by hue more than by value. The waves behind it are soft and the contrast is gentle. The red knot is a small accent. The result is close to real.
The boot sits well against the orange rings, with a clear glow behind it. The boot's darkest spots are small, and the sole and heel look slightly murky. The result is close to lesson c081.
The dark purple hat against the bright orange gives a strong value separation. The hat is a large dark mass with little internal modelling. The glow behind it is good.

Everything sits in the same light-to-mid band, so the hero is separated more by hue than by value. The club head is a grey-blue lilac close to the grass tones. The sky is much brighter than the rest, and the grass blades are busy at the bottom.
